Let me analyze this ticket.

Employee: Jacob Ellison (E040)
Requested: admin access to Source Code

Facts:
- Role: Payroll Specialist
- Employment type: contractor
- Security training: basic

Policy:
1. full_time employees: up to write. Admin only if role owns system.
2. contractor employees: read, or write if they have advanced security training. Never admin.

Jacob is a contractor with basic training. So maximum is read (no write without advanced training, never admin).

Requested admin > max read, so grant max read.

Both notes recommend read. Decision: read.
